items.title: Power outages hit France as record heatwave set to peak
items.description: About 68,000 homes in Brittany have been affected, with electricity unlikely to be fully restored until Wednesday night.

items.title: Congress passes war powers measure for first time, breaking with Trump over Iran
items.description: The resolution passed on Tuesday was largely symbolic, but it adds to pressure on the White House to end the conflict once and for all.

items.title: UN says it will evacuate sailors stranded in Strait of Hormuz, as Rubio warns against tolls
items.description: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio warned Iran that no country can charge fees for ships to travel through the strait.

items.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
items.description: Rafael Grossi says the global nuclear watchdog is "working on modalities" but an Iranian  minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

items.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
items.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

items.title: Ukraine strikes knock out power in key city in Russian-occupied Crimea
items.description: Sevastopol's Moscow-installed governor warns there will be no electricity in some areas until the evening.

items.title: France confirms first Ebola case
items.description: More than 260 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo are known to have died during the current outbreak.
